title: LIVE Coverage: 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila, Nov. 17
summary: Philstar.com's special coverage of the ASEAN Summit and related meetings in Manila, with real-time updates and analyses.

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines hosts the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit and Related Summits from November 15 to 18 in Manila.

Southeast Asian leaders, dialogue partners and representatives of international institutions to discuss regional and global concerns led by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. are set to convene at the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC) in Pasay City for the plenary and retreat. They are expected to take stock of the Philippines' 2026 chairship and discuss key regional challenges.
